title: Southern Dreams on 30A
meta_description: Southern Dreams on 30A --- a breezy 4BR coastal retreat near Santa Rosa Beach with pool access, BBQ, golf cart + beach days on 30A.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Southern Dreams on 30A by AvantStay, a bright and breezy coastal retreat designed for easy group getaways just moments from the sugar-white sands of Florida's iconic Emerald Coast.
⠀
Tucked into the laid-back charm of Santa Rosa Beach along the western stretch of 30A, this home places you right where you want to be---close to beach access, local favorites like Stinky's Fish Camp, and the shops, dining, and live music of Gulf Place Town Center. Spend your days biking along scenic paths, lounging by the Gulf, or exploring nearby coastal dune lakes and state parks before returning to your own relaxing home base.
⠀
Inside, the home's open-concept layout creates a natural flow between the living, dining, and kitchen spaces, making it easy for everyone to gather. The living room offers comfortable seating for movie nights, while the dining table for six invites shared meals and conversation. In the kitchen, stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and a breakfast bar make everything from quick breakfasts to full dinners feel effortless.
⠀
Step outside to enjoy the Florida sunshine. Fire up the BBQ for an evening cookout, unwind in the outdoor lounge, or settle into the back porch where the sound of ocean waves and birdsong sets the pace for the day. Mornings are just as easy---sip your coffee from the balcony chairs as the neighborhood slowly comes to life. Guests also have access to a shared community pool---perfect for cooling off after a beach day.
⠀
With four thoughtfully arranged bedrooms, the home comfortably sleeps up to 14 guests. The primary suite on the main level features a king bed and private ensuite bathroom, offering a peaceful retreat. Two additional queen bedrooms share a full bathroom, while the bunk room is a favorite for kids and groups alike, featuring two twin-over-full bunks plus a sleeper sofa and its own shared bathroom. A half bath on the main level and in-home washer and dryer add extra convenience for longer stays.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside to Santa Rosa Beach and beyond, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A golf cart is available on-site for guest use. A signed liability waiver is required.

Parking Details:
- Driveway parking for up to 3 cars plus 1 golf cart. No street parking allowed---violators may be towed.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

STR Permit: STR-104354
